Comment #3 on issue 3 by Matthieu.Stigler: clean the handling of arg th in
selectSETAR & friends
http://code.google.com/p/tsdyn/issues/detail?id=3

I followed Antonio advice and added some function who just check that there
is only
one arg given and return the inputs as outputs. It has as further advantage
that the
help file for MakeThSpec is separated and so help file for selectSETAR is
less
"crowded".

the trick used is just:

exCheck<-ifelse(is.null(exact),0,1)
inCheck<-ifelse(int==c("from","to"),0,1)
aroundCheck<-ifelse(around=="val",0,1)
if(sum(exCheck, inCheck, aroundCheck)>1)
stop("Only one of the makeThSpec args should be specified")

So if this is ok, it will be extended to TVAR and TVECM and the issue
closed.
